description: Mint a new primary account nv_ key from email OTP. No Bearer key required. WARNING: revokes the previous primary account key; named keys (create_api_key) keep working unless revoke_all is true. Also verifies email if needed.

code.description: OTP from resend_verification or the latest verification email.

email.description: Account email that owns the key.

revoke_all.description: Also revoke every named key. Use when a key may have leaked. Default false.

name: reissue_key
title: Reissue API key
